decisions.support_explanation: A label alone does not support the added clinical definition of retinal inflammation.

The evidence mixes incoming and outgoing subclass edges and gives no readable labels for their endpoints. Retinitis pigmentosa and the broader classification are not established by those cited inputs.

review_provenance: Separate Codex review of saved OpenAI gpt-4o-mini draft claims against exact cited original values, complete packet missingness and typed focal identities; generator self-approval and citation membership are insufficient.
